title: boltons: Bug report from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is boltons (an open-source Python library). Bug report from a user of this library:

> `boltons.listutils.BarrelList` doesn't slice like a list. Negative bounds, bounds past the end and negative steps give results that differ from the same slice on a plain `list` (for example `bl[::-1]` or `bl[-20:2]`). Every slice should give exactly what `list(bl)[slice]` gives, including `ValueError` for a step of 0.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
